svg.title: Accountability: People Answer for AI
svg.desc: When an incident happens, the question is who answers for it. Saying the model did it means nobody owns the fix, and blaming the model provider fails too: its filters help safety, but accountability can't be outsourced. The deploying organisation answers for it and governs and monitors its own use case through four measures: a named owner with an escalation path, a review board that approves changes, human sign-off for consequential decisions with audit logs, and an agreed way to pause, roll back or retire the system.
svg.text: Responsibility never moves to the model or its provider; the deploying organisation owns it.
